description: Recolor an editable .mcpx source with a builtin material id, optionally limited to one region id, and return PNG bytes and/or the recolored source.

family.description: Palette family id to apply (mutually exclusive with material).

material.description: Builtin material id to apply (mutually exclusive with family).

outputMcpxPath.description: Explicit .mcpx output path. When omitted, the .mcpx text is embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

outputPngPath.description: Explicit PNG output path. When omitted, the PNG bytes are embedded in the result instead of written to disk.

region.description: Limit the write to one region id; otherwise every layer is recolored.

selection.description: Scope pixel writes with a selection expression.

style.description: Style preset id or .style.json path; defaults to vanilla.

name: recolor_asset
